description: Grade 5 optional enrichment example: rewrite one bar from 3/4 to 9/8.

provenance.authoredBy: Music Theory Path curriculum team (Brief 10 addendum)

item.prompt: Rewrite this bar of 3/4 in 9/8 so every note and rest keeps the same share of its beat. Beam by the new beats.

music.textAlternative: One bar of 3/4 (three crotchet beats), unpitched rhythm on a single line.

hints: 3/4 has three crotchet beats; 9/8 has three dotted-crotchet beats. Match each beat to its partner.

feedback.correct: Correct. The three crotchet beats of 3/4 become three dotted-crotchet beats in 9/8. The rest takes the same share of its beat as the note it replaces, so it is dotted too.

mistakes.values-copied-unchanged: Copying the values leaves a bar of the wrong length for 9/8. Compare one beat in each time signature first.
mistakes.rest-not-rewritten: A rest fills the same share of the beat as a note, so it changes in exactly the same way.
mistakes.dots-kept-in-simple-time: A simple beat is undotted, so the dots must come off when going from compound to simple time.
mistakes.beam-across-beats: Start a new beam on each new beat so the beats stay visible.

feedback.fallback: The three crotchet beats of 3/4 become three dotted-crotchet beats in 9/8. The rest takes the same share of its beat as the note it replaces, so it is dotted too.
